A new install no longer greets you with a failure that has not happened, and the interface no longer shows anyone else's name.

## Nothing is broken on your first launch

Opening Create on a fresh install used to say:

> La stratégie n'a pas pu être lue. Vos cibles existent peut-être déjà : rouvrez l'écran Stratégie pour vérifier.

Nothing had failed. There was simply no strategy yet, because the application had just been installed. Under the hood, "no strategy" and "cannot read the strategy" arrived as the same thing, and the screen read it as the worse of the two.

The two are now told apart. A fresh install reads what it should have said all along: *"Aucune cible définie. Créez-en une dans l'écran Stratégie, onglet Cibles."*

## The name in the profile field

The Profile screen suggested a real person's name as an example of what to type. This application is public and installed by anyone, so that example put someone else's identity in front of every user. The field now says what it wants: *"Votre nom, tel qu'il apparaît sur LinkedIn"*.

## Under the hood

The application now runs on Electron 43 and a newer SQLite engine, and is built and tested on a supported Node release. None of this changes anything you can see, and everything you have written is untouched.

Screens are now also checked on a brand new workspace, not only on one that already holds content. That is how both problems above were found: they were only visible to someone opening the application for the first time.
